text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —So! Refreshing!!
choice_data_list: Did that heavy feeling go away?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Toss, toss☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Racing is the absolute best, no contest!
It blows away all the sadness and bad memories in an instant☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah, gotcha☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And that got me thinking!
Shouldn't I go apologize to Ojou!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: The Shinkansen!!
choice_data_list: At least let me get changed first...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly gathered my bags and chased after her, but
I was powerless against Daitaku Helios's sheer momentum—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ruby~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Ms. Helios.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Listen up!
I—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am terribly sorry for what happened.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I acted quite immaturely back then.
I apologize for making you uncomfortable.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whaaa!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't it be me, though!?
Sorr—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I cannot accept your apology.
Please also withdraw your claim that this was an insult.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
R-Really?
Well, as long as you're okay with it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for understanding.
By the way, that outfit...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I made a bullet train☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nope, nope!
Total attention grabber☆

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "...I'm sure you must have achieved remarkable results."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Yeah!
That's right, but...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware of Ms. Helios's achievements.
Even among her generation, she stands out significantly.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
From now on, the sprint division
will surely revolve around you.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Eeeehhh!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Milady... praised...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Uhehehehe~~âª
Motherrr!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, like, woww,
you're from the same generation too, Ojou~."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So, you know...
Nihihi.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If Ojo comes over to our side too,
we could totally, like, pull off a one-two finish, don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "Over here"... Meaning?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The number one sprint couple!
We could even start a Heli-Ruby Channel♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Whaa, are you serious~!?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"If we ever face each other in a race again,
please don't hold back at all.
...If that opportunity ever comes, that is."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I still have training left, so please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Do your best~~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: All changed~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Thx a bunch~! 
Wait, listen!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, ojousama totally
praised me to high heaven just now, didn't she!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that insane!?
Isn't this a first!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I dunno why, but during races,
the young lady actually watches me—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I just realized something crazy!
Look at this!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"If I get crazy strong,
the Missus is gonna heap crazy praise on me, don'cha think?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Beyond just praise... won't you fall head over heels for me instead~?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wahaha, funny face!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be frank, Daitaku Helios's wishes feel a bit
too optimistic... but boosting her motivation
is definitely a good thing.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, wait, wait!!
Isn't this next race super important!?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Is there something!?
Like, you know...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: The stuff that makes Helios super-duper strong~♪!
choice_data_list: In that case, I guess it has to be a G1...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has proven her presence among her own generation.
If we are to take the next step,
I'd like to see her face the older generation, but...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Okie-dokie!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You've got some crazy highlights in mind, right, Trainy-P?
Btw, what kinda stuff?
choice_data_list: I think Bamboo Memory will show up

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oooh!
If it isn't Vam-chamu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory.
She was chosen as Best Sprinter last year,
and was also a rival to that Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
He really does feel like a strict demon!
I even accidentally called him "Teach"!
choice_data_list: They're insanely tough, but it'd be amazing if you can win!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa~! For real? For real-real?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Now that's totally firing me up! Alright, alright,
if I beat Bamboo—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Helios-chan,
wuv you...☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...is waiting for me!
I've gotta go for it~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios was totally pumped up.
And so, her next goal was set
for the Mile Championship!
